submitted.rationale: Index 5 has the least Cu in the library, with Bi and V at about 1:1, which puts it closest to BiVO4, the best-known photoanode in this system. It gave the highest measured photocurrent, 1.06e-5 A. That beat index 8, which is Bi-rich (6.1e-6 A), and index 89, from the Cu-V oxide region (1.4e-7 A).

rejected.reason: Cu-V oxide region (about Cu3V2O8), photocurrent 1.4e-7 A, about 75x lower than index 5
Bi-rich and V-poor compared with BiVO4, with slightly more Cu; photocurrent 6.1e-6 A, lower than index 5
